expects.query:
Using the `/vss-setup-behavior-analytics` skill, end-to-end and autonomously, deploy the `vss-behavior-analytics` service on this host in a **single container that performs BOTH video-search AND alerting at the same time** — produces behaviors + embeddings (for search) AND generates incidents (for alerts). Use the repo-owned canonical combined config documented by the skill; do not try to synthesize or write a merged host config from inside the sandbox.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A bare Brev host with Docker + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY` for image pull. `vss-behavior-analytics` is **CPU-only** (`gpu_count: 0` = skip GPU-type / count enforcement; `ANY` = no-constraint pool selector). A live message broker / perception input is NOT required — this task verifies the service is **deployed with the correct app + configuration**, so it is fine if the container restart-loops waiting for a broker.
checks: `docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-behavior-analytics` returns exit 0 (the exact `vss-behavior-analytics` container was created; do not select a similarly named sibling container)

`docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}'` shows `main_search_and_alerts_app.py` followed by the `--config` argument `/resources/vss-search-analytics-config.json` (the combined search/alerts app and its active config are used)

`config_dest=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' | jq -r 'index("--config") as $i | if $i == null then empty else .[$i + 1] end'); test "$config_dest" = /resources/vss-search-analytics-config.json && config_src=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Mounts}}' | jq -r --arg dest "$config_dest" '.[] | select(.Destination == $dest) | .Source' | head -1) && test -f "$config_src" && jq -e '[.app[] | select(.name == "numWorkersForIncidentGeneration" or .name == "numWorkersForBehaviorCreation" or .name == "numWorkersForEmbedFiltering") | (.value | tonumber)] | length == 3 and all(.[]; . > 0)' "$config_src"` returns exit 0. This derives the active config from the exact container's `--config` argument, maps it to the mount with the same `Destination`, and proves all three search-and-alerts processors have non-zero worker counts; do not evaluate any other mounted config.
